content:
The Paranormal Chronicles Podcast welcomes author and researcher Brit Elders for a compelling investigation into one of the most controversial UFO contact cases ever recorded.

LISTEN NOW ON SPOTIFY: https://open.spotify.com/episode/20RpE1rQdQQQXId633Th4D

Hosted by bestselling paranormal author G. L. Davies, Inside the World’s Most Extraordinary UFO Case! explores the astonishing story of Swiss farmer Billy Meier, who claimed to have experienced repeated contact with extraterrestrial beings from the Pleiades.

For decades, the Billy Meier case has fascinated, divided and challenged UFO researchers. Meier presented an extraordinary collection of photographs, films, audio recordings, metal samples and detailed accounts of alleged encounters with otherworldly visitors. Are these materials evidence of genuine extraterrestrial contact, an elaborate deception, or something even more difficult to explain?

In this unmissable episode, Davies is joined by Brit Elders, co-author of UFO…Contact from the Pleiades: 45th Anniversary Edition. Combining two landmark photo-journal volumes, the book documents the remarkable investigation conducted by Brit and Lee Elders alongside Lieutenant Colonel Wendelle C. Stevens. It features hundreds of images and written accounts connected to a case that continues to provoke debate around the world.

Brit takes listeners behind the famous photographs and sensational headlines, sharing her first-hand perspective on the investigation, the evidence examined and the people at the centre of this enduring UFO mystery.

Whether you are a committed UFO researcher, a sceptical observer or simply fascinated by unexplained phenomena, this episode offers an absorbing journey into a case unlike any other.

Listen now and decide for yourself: Was Billy Meier really in contact with visitors from beyond our world?
